lines.rom: suna meri devi parvatavasini tera para na paya
pana supari dhvaja nariyala le teri bhemta carhaya
suva coli tere amga virajai kesara tilaka lagaya namge pamva tere akabara jakara sone ka chatra carhaya
umce umce parvata bana devalaya nice sahara basaya satyuga treta dvapara madhye kalayuga raja savaya
